fps.description: Frames per second for the generated GIF.
fps.title: Fps

periodic.description: Allow training windows to wrap past the end of `training_sequence` back to the start, treating it as cyclic. Used only when training (state is absent); ignored otherwise.
periodic.title: Periodic

quality.description: Training effort, used only when training (i.e. `state` is absent): fast is quick and rough, complete trains longest on the most data.
quality.title: Quality

seed.description: Top-level RNG seed for training. Used only when training (state is absent); None picks a random seed for this run, recorded in the returned state so the exact run can be reproduced later by passing it back explicitly. Ignored when continuing from a state — its own build seed is always reused, since a different value would reconstruct a different physical reservoir than the one the readout was trained against.
seed.title: Seed

training_sequence.description: Sequence of filenames from `vocabulary`, in training order. Required when `state` is not given (there's nothing yet to continue from); ignored otherwise.
training_sequence.title: Training Sequence

variation.description: Sampling temperature: low = deterministic/repetitive, high = random
variation.title: Variation

outputFiles.name: state
outputFiles.description: Advanced reservoir state; reuse on a later call as job:<id>/state.
